prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: desktop AI redesign concept bitmap for TALKPIK AI user app
Primary request: Create concept-02 for page 25-X-03-paywall, state default. Reference state: subscription selection screen. Make this concept benefit-led: users compare plan value without feeling like a marketing landing page.
Composition/framing: desktop 1280x900 edge-to-edge app UI screenshot only; no browser address bar, tabs, bookmarks bar, OS frame, device frame, or watermark. Preserve sidebar. Header with title and explanatory text. Top: centered plan grid, three plan cards monthly/quarterly/annual; quarterly selected/recommended with subtle border and Obsidian button. Each card includes price, cadence, concise benefit bullets. Lower: two panels, left subscription benefits with feature checklist, right payment/payment-prep guide and refund/tax notes. Bottom actions: subscription management, back.
Style/medium: high-fidelity Ant Design pricing UI inside an app workspace, compact density, neutral and trustworthy, no full-bleed hero.
Color palette: Mist/Snow/Fog/Obsidian; Obsidian #09090b as the only primary CTA; muted neutral recommendation badge; no gradient or colorful plan backgrounds.
Typography: Cosmica-like modern sans, Korean UI text as visual direction only, no negative letter spacing, clear price hierarchy.
Must preserve state signals: subscription paywall, three plan options, recommended quarterly option, benefits, payment guide, select buttons, manage subscription/back actions, no actual payment completion.
Avoid: browser chrome, OS frame, device frame, loud marketing gradients, chromatic CTA set, decorative illustration, huge rounded cards, heavy shadows.
